Container.Name: CloudflareSSL
Container.Overview: A small Docker container that generates Let's Encrypt certificates for Unraid using the Cloudflare API allowing to avoid "this page is not secure" warnings when connecting to Unraid locally.
Container.Description: A small Docker container that generates Let's Encrypt certificates for Unraid using the Cloudflare API allowing to avoid "this page is not secure" warnings when connecting to Unraid locally.
Container.Changes:
## CloudflareSSL Change Log
### 0.2.0 (2026-01-25) - Change Unraid bundle path to /etc/ssl/unraid_bundle.pem Note: It is now required to set the path to the hosts unraid bundle during the initial setup.
### 0.1.0 (2026-01-24) - Initial Release

Config.Name: Cloudflare API Token
Config.Description: Token to authenticate against the Cloudflare API endpoint.

Config.Name: Email
Config.Description: Email address for Let's Encrypt notifications.

Config.Name: Domains
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of domains for which to obtain the certificate.

Config.Name: Key Type
Config.Description: Type of private key to generate (e.g. ecdsa, rsa).

Config.Name: Renewal Interval
Config.Description: Interval between certificate renewal checks. Set to 0 to disable renewals and only run once.

Config.Name: Unraid SSL Bundle
Config.Description: Path to the Unraid SSL bundle file. This should be stored in /boot/config/ssl/certs/HOSTNAME_unraid_bundle.pem
